book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第一册
unit_cn: Unit 3 Faster, Higher, Stronger 更快更高更强
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第一册 Unit 3 词表(p116-117 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、运动/竞赛主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: The National Basketball Association is famous all over the world.
words.example_cn: 美国职业篮球协会闻名世界。

words.example_en: Stephen learned to play on a muddy court near his home.
words.example_cn: 斯蒂芬在家附近一个泥泞的球场上学会了打球。

words.example_en: On a rough court the ball can bounce in all directions.
words.example_cn: 在不平的球场上,球会向四面八方弹跳。

words.example_en: He played far beyond everyone's expectation that season.
words.example_cn: 那个赛季他的表现远远超出了所有人的预期。

words.example_en: His philosophy is to work hard every single day.
words.example_cn: 他的人生哲学就是每一天都努力训练。

words.example_en: Video technology makes sure that no player can cheat.
words.example_cn: 视频技术确保没有选手能够作弊。

words.example_en: The award honours remarkable sportspeople from around the world.
words.example_cn: 该奖项表彰来自世界各地的非凡运动员。

words.example_en: She sent the ball straight over the net.
words.example_cn: 她把球直接打过了球网。

words.example_en: The final in Rio paints a vivid picture of the team's spirit.
words.example_cn: 里约的决赛生动地展现了这支队伍的精神。

words.example_en: The team was assigned to a very tough group.
words.example_cn: 这支队伍被分到了一个非常艰难的小组。

words.example_en: They faced several strong opponents in the group stage.
words.example_cn: 他们在小组赛阶段遇到了几个强劲的对手。

words.example_en: One player returned only months after heart surgery.
words.example_cn: 一名队员在心脏手术后仅几个月就复出了。

words.example_en: The Chinese team defeated the Netherlands in the semi-final.
words.example_cn: 中国队在半决赛中战胜了荷兰队。

words.example_en: With steely nerves, they won the final match.
words.example_cn: 凭着钢铁般的意志,他们赢得了决赛。

words.example_en: They played a close match to seize the gold medal.
words.example_cn: 他们打了一场势均力敌的比赛,夺得了金牌。

words.example_en: Cooperation between team members is the key to success.
words.example_cn: 队员之间的合作是成功的关键。

words.example_en: I watched the relay final at our annual sports tournament.
words.example_cn: 我在学校一年一度的运动会上观看了接力决赛。

words.example_en: The atmosphere at the sports event was very intense.
words.example_cn: 这场体育赛事的气氛非常紧张。

words.example_en: The NBA has bright lights and shiny courts.
words.example_cn: 美职篮拥有明亮的灯光和闪亮的球场。

words.example_en: Only a perfect shot went into the heavy basket.
words.example_cn: 只有完美的投篮才能进入那个沉重的篮筐。

words.example_en: The weak plastic backboard gave way with every shot.
words.example_cn: 那块脆弱的塑料篮板每投一次就往下垮一点。

words.example_en: The bumps on the road made the ball bounce strangely.
words.example_cn: 路上的凸起使球弹得很怪。

words.example_en: Daily practice helped him sharpen his skills.
words.example_cn: 每天的练习帮助他提高了球技。

words.example_en: He thanked his teammates for their hard work.
words.example_cn: 他感谢队友们的辛勤付出。

words.example_en: Many expected him to follow in his father's footsteps.
words.example_cn: 许多人期待他继承父亲的事业。

words.example_en: He joined the Golden State Warriors in 2009.
words.example_cn: 他于2009年加入了金州勇士队。

words.example_en: Through self-belief and hard work, he reached the top.
words.example_cn: 凭着自信和努力,他登上了顶峰。

words.example_en: He learned a lot with the help of an old hoop.
words.example_cn: 他靠着一个旧篮圈学到了很多。

words.example_en: Some older members enjoy yoga to keep their muscles toned.
words.example_cn: 一些年长的会员喜欢练瑜伽来保持肌肉的力量。

words.example_en: The Chinese spiker sent the ball straight back.
words.example_cn: 中国队的主攻手把球直接扣了回去。

words.example_en: The young player seemed to burst into the national team overnight.
words.example_cn: 这名年轻球员仿佛一夜之间就闯进了国家队。

words.example_en: They reached the quarter-final as the fourth team in the group.
words.example_cn: 他们以小组第四的身份打进了四分之一决赛。

words.example_en: They had only two wins in the preliminary matches.
words.example_cn: 他们在预赛中只取得了两场胜利。

words.example_en: Their perseverance paid off with an epic comeback.
words.example_cn: 他们的坚持以一场史诗般的反扑得到了回报。

words.example_en: They beat the Netherlands in the semi-final.
words.example_cn: 他们在半决赛中击败了荷兰队。

words.example_en: Strong nerve helped them stay calm in the final.
words.example_cn: 强大的意志力帮助他们在决赛中保持冷静。

words.example_en: Team spirit was the special ingredient in their success.
words.example_cn: 团队精神是他们成功的特殊要素。

words.example_en: Teamwork is the key to the team's victory.
words.example_cn: 团队配合是球队取胜的关键。

words.example_en: As soon as a team steps off the podium, new challenges begin.
words.example_cn: 一支队伍一走下领奖台,新的挑战就开始了。

words.example_en: Despite all the doubts, Stephen decided to carry on.
words.example_cn: 尽管有种种质疑,斯蒂芬还是决定继续坚持。

words.example_en: The old backboard would give way with every shot.
words.example_cn: 那块旧篮板每投一次球就会往下垮一点。

words.example_en: They believed their hard work would pay off in the end.
words.example_cn: 他们相信努力最终会有回报。

words.example_en: He won the Most Valuable Player award for two years in a row.
words.example_cn: 他连续两年获得最有价值球员奖。

words.example_en: At the age of 68, he was brave enough to try roller skating.
words.example_cn: 在68岁时,他还有勇气尝试滑旱冰。

words.meaning_cn: 突然出现在(指突然成功)
words.example_en: In the 1980s, the team burst onto the world stage.
words.example_cn: 在20世纪80年代,这支队伍突然登上了世界舞台。
